title: Builder's Shulkers
description: Open your shulker boxes from your inventory, and hold one in your hotbar to place blocks straight from it !
body:
Builder's Shulkers lets you use a shulker box's contents without ever placing it down. Open and rearrange one straight from your inventory, and place blocks from a shulker held in your hotbar while you build.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/VknrkiXw_Fk" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Build straight from your hotbar

![Pocket-Build Demo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/GfiZGjmF/images/507999e875939335104f1ea4efe051e0d81147e1.gif)

*   Hold a shulker box in your hotbar and press **Ctrl + right-click** to enter Pocket-Build mode
*   Scroll the mouse wheel to select the previous/next different block inside the box. Its name and count show by your hotbar, and the box opens with a dissolving lid that reveals the selected block rendered inside it
*   Right-click to place that block straight from the box while the box stays in your hand
*   Middle-click a block you already have in the box to jump straight to it
*   Hold Ctrl to peek at the box's full contents in an overlay above your hotbar

## Open and manage shulker boxes from your inventory

![Shulker-Inventory Demo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/GfiZGjmF/images/50bc41e62afa08ea27b2ed6c040b8f409903eb97.gif)

*   Right-click a shulker box in your inventory to open it
*   Move items in and out with all the usual controls: left and right click, shift-click, drag, hotbar number keys, and drop
*   Close it with Escape, or by right-clicking the same shulker again
*   While one is open, you can right-click another to switch straight to it
*   There are open and close sounds, and the lid smoothly animates

## Multiplayer

![Multiplayer Animations Demo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/GfiZGjmF/images/cfe0ca6404edfe3eceebb0612f18ae9412e6b5ba.gif)

*   Works in multiplayer, including the lid animations on shulkers other players hold
*   **Players without the mod can still join the server normally**: they simply do not see the extra animations and sounds

## Designed to fit in

*   Vanilla+: improves shulker handling without changing how the game looks or feels
*   Built on the vanilla shulker container (same screen, same data), so it plays nicely with most other mods, and it works with shulker boxes added by other mods

## Customization
*   **Settings screen**: Press B (rebindable) to open it and tune the cosmetics: lid animations, the lid effect (dissolve, disappear, or stay solid), the block rendered inside the box and its count, the open/close sounds, and more.
*   **Custom keybinds**: Every control lives in Options -> Controls under "Builder's Shulkers" and can be rebound or unbound: the Pocket-Build hold key (default Left Control), a peek key (default Left Control), and a single-press "Toggle Pocket-Build" (unbound by default) to enter and leave the mode with one button (handy on a controller or on touch).
*   **Gamerules**: Server admins can turn the access from inventory and Pocket-Build features on or off.

## Safe by design

*   Everything that moves items is handled by the server, so your items can never be duplicated

## Requirements

*   Minecraft 26.1.x or 26.2
*   Fabric Loader and Fabric API

Put this mod and Fabric API in your `mods` folder.

## Open source
